answer: Vouch-budget quorum caps every established identity in the shared atlas at three endorsements per epoch, and a newcomer needs three independent vouchers before transacting. An attacker bonds collateral per puppet identity, pays registration per attempt, and waits one liveness pulse plus two epochs before a voucher's weight counts. Because endorsements are rate-capped and standing erodes like a dune unless renewed by real activity, a ring of fakes can only vouch inward, forming a closed cluster with no external quorum, so its identities never reach the threshold.
